[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested appetizers include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Samosas: Crunchy fried or baked pastries filled with spiced potatoes, peas, and onions, served with chutney.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Paneer Tikka: Marinated paneer skewers grilled and served with cilantro-lime yogurt sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Spinach and Artichoke Pakora: Crispy fritters filled with creamy spinach and artichoke, served with mint chutney.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Mango Lassi Shrimp: Shrimp marinated in yogurt, mango puree, and spices, then grilled.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Garam Masala Deviled Eggs: Deviled eggs infused with garam masala and cumin.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Cauliflower Gajjar: Roasted cauliflower in a spicy tomato-based sauce, garnished with cilantro and crispy onions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Bhel Puri: Indian street food made with crispy puris, chutneys, potatoes, onions, and chickpeas.
